info.title: LXMF SDK RPC Core Contract
info.description: Canonical OpenRPC contract for the core LXMF SDK v2 RPC methods. Release-domain methods remain on the legacy schema path during the initial migration.

methods.name: sdk_negotiate_v2
methods.summary: Negotiate runtime capabilities and contract version.

methods.name: sdk_send_v2
methods.summary: Queue an outbound message for delivery.

methods.name: sdk_send_batch_v2
methods.summary: Queue a batch of outbound messages for delivery.

methods.name: sdk_status_v2
methods.summary: Read the status for a message.

methods.name: sdk_cancel_message_v2
methods.summary: Attempt to cancel an in-flight message.
